llm.summary: The skill appears to be what it says (a local persistent memory integration) and its declared requirements line up with the description, but the installation instructions (curl | sh) and the lack of shipped code mean you should review the installer/daemon before running it and be cautious about file access and network behavior.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the declared requirement (grantai-mcp) and the SKILL.md describes a memory service exposing command-line tools. Requiring a single MCP binary is consistent with the described functionality.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions describe importing files/directories, capturing conversation turns verbatim, and importing git history — all legitimate for a memory service but they imply the tool will read arbitrary project files and commit history. The SKILL.md does not instruct the agent to read unrelated system secrets, but users should expect the tool to access local files and potentially sensitive repo data when asked.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec in the registry, but SKILL.md instructs users to run curl -fsSL https://solonai.com/install.sh | sh, which downloads and executes a script from the vendor site. That pattern is convenient but high-risk: it runs arbitrary remote code. The Docker image is hosted on GHCR (reasonable).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables or credentials are requested in metadata. That aligns with the 'free, automatic activation, no license key' claim. The tool will need filesystem access to import data, which is proportionate to a memory service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request system-wide config changes in its metadata. SKILL.md asks the user to add an MCP entry to the OpenClaw config (normal for a tool-backed skill). Nothing indicates it modifies other skills or requires permanent elevated presence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent with its stated purpose (a local persistent memory service) but exercise caution before installing. The SKILL.md tells you to run a remote install script (curl | sh) — review that script or prefer the Docker image/official package instead of piping to a shell. Expect the service to read project files, .git history, and conversation text when you ask it to learn or capture — don't import secrets or sensitive directories. Verify the binary (grantai-mcp) or run it in a container/sandbox, check network activity after startup if you need assurance that data is truly local, and contact the vendor/support if you need evidence of the '100% local' and encryption claims.
